sanskrit_verse:
तथ्येन हि प्रमाणं तु दोषेणैव तु दूषणम् ।
एवं दुष्टं नृपस्थाने यस्मिंस्तद्धि विचार्यते ॥
transliteration: tathyena hi pramāṇaṃ tu doṣeṇaiva tu dūṣaṇam | evaṃ duṣṭaṃ nṛpasthāne yasmiṃs tad dhi vicāryate ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Truth alone is the valid means of knowledge; fault alone constitutes defamation. When such defamation occurs within the domain of the king, it shall be examined accordingly.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in the sovereign's capacity to uphold truth as the sole epistemic foundation
Causation arises from alignment with pramāṇa (valid cognition) rather than subjective interpretation
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by one’s proximity and access to truthful discernment
Restoration logic requires rectification of false attribution through re-establishment of factual integrity
Consciousness alignment demands correction of cognitive distortion without degradation of being
executable_legal_axioms: IF a statement contradicts pramāṇa THEN classify it as doṣa AND initiate restoration protocol
IF defamation occurs within sovereign jurisdiction THEN evaluate based on epistemic validity NOT emotional impact
IF actor possesses epistemic capacity AND knowingly transmits falsehood THEN assign completion process for realignment
IF no intent to falsify BUT error occurred due to negligence THEN mandate pramāṇa-realignment training
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this principle establishes that only statements verifiably contrary to pramāṇa qualify as actionable defamation. The court must assess not moral culpability but epistemic congruence. Responsibility thresholds are calibrated to the individual’s access to valid cognition and their duty to exercise it.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa functions as the immutable causal basis for all lawful assertion. Defamation emerges when anupūrvaśaḥ (causal sequence) deviates from this basis. Thus, corrective action aligns the speaker’s cognition back to pramāṇa without punitive intent. Responsibility scales proportionally with epistemic access and societal role.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate pramāṇa reaffirmation process involving guided cognition realignment
Assign public recitation of corrected facts under conscious attunement supervision
Implement reflective documentation practice where falsehood originator records cause and rectification steps
Enforce temporary withdrawal from authoritative speech platforms until cognitive integrity restored
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Sanatana Dharma Law: Truth stands as sole witness; defamation dissolves upon realignment with pramāṇa. Justice flows from consciousness clarity, not coercive consequence. Dharma is restored.
